report_discrepancies.note: General Fund general government on the governmental funds statement is 1,144,296; the General Fund departments schedule (p22) gives the General department total 3,032,174 less capital outlay 1,887,879 = 1,144,295.

General Fund environment and leisure on the governmental funds statement is 2,757,382; the departments schedule (pp22-23) gives the leisure departments excluding capital outlay 2,741,137 + Capital Projects department non-capital 16,246 = 2,757,383. The two 1-dollar gaps offset (total expenditures 11,379,755 agree).

notes: GAAP report (governmental modified accrual, business-type accrual), same layout and choices as FY2023. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p7); Loan/bond proceeds 5,525,000 is printed among revenues (inside Total revenues 24,921,038), so it is a receipt line (Debt Proceeds), as in FY2024/FY2025. Transfers printed only net per fund ('Transfer from (to) other funds'; Total column net (101,634)); gross in/out summed from fund columns (pp6-7), Other Funds column net (23,270) counted as out. ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet Total column Cash and cash equivalents 8,402,355 (p5); certificates of deposit 13,375,932 in ending_investments; county treasurer cash 125,576 (p5) not added (as FY2023). beginning_cash not printed. Business-type lines from the proprietary funds statement Total enterprise column (p9; internal service fund excluded); business-type receipts total computed (operating + nonoperating revenues); disbursements total 6,789,048 = Statement of Activities business-type expenses (p2) = operating expenses 6,104,996 + interest 457,021 + fees 227,031. Utility 'Other revenue' put in charges for services because the Statement of Activities charges for services per utility equal each fund's total operating revenues. Proprietary cash flows from the Total enterprise column (p11). Balance sheet from the Statement of Net Position (p1), governmental and business-type columns. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp22-23; modified accrual, more detailed than the cash-basis General Fund budget schedule p14, which is not recorded); Capital Projects department's non-capital lines assigned to culture/recreation by the statement tie (see report_discrepancies). Street, CDBG, Debt Service, LB 357 and Capital Projects funds from their cash-basis budgetary comparison schedules (pp15-19); Street Fund 'Grants' line (actual '-', budget 138,694) not recorded. Nonmajor funds per fund from the combining statement (pp20-21); E911 has no expenditures. Utility funds from the proprietary statement fund columns (p9; no budget schedules printed). CDBG schedule has a single expenditure line (no total line). Read pages 1-23 of 23
